import { Request, Response } from 'express'
import { MeetingService } from '../services/meeting.service'
import { ApiResponse } from '../utils/apiResponse'

export const getCalendarEvents = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  const meetings = await MeetingService.getUpcomingMeetings()

  const events = meetings.map((m: any) => ({
    id: m._id || m.roomId,
    roomId: m.roomId,
    title: m.title || 'Meeting',
    start: m.scheduledStartTime || m.createdAt,
    durationMinutes: m.durationMinutes || 45,
    timezone: m.timezone || 'UTC',
    status: m.status || 'scheduled',
    hostName: m.hostName || 'Organizer',
    attendees: m.attendees || [],
  }))

  ApiResponse.success(res, events, 'Calendar events retrieved successfully')
}

  speaker: string
  speakerName?: string
  text: string
  startTime?: number
  endTime?: number
  timestamp?: string
  language?: string
}

export interface StructuredSummary {
  meetingOverview: string
  discussionPoints: string[]
  importantDecisions: string[]
  keyHighlights: string[]
  problemsDiscussed: string[]
  proposedSolutions: string[]
  followUpRequirements: string[]

  generatedBy: 'openai' | 'contextual_nlp'

  createdAt: string

  id?: string | number

  assignee: string
  dueDate?: string | null
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'

  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'

  question: string
  answer: string
  citations: string[]
  confidence: number
  generatedBy: string
}

  meetingId: string
  durationFormatted: string
  topicsDiscussed: string[]
  actionItemsCount: number
  completedTasksCount: number
  pendingTasksCount: number
  summary: StructuredSummary
  actionItems: ExtractedActionItem[]

  type: 'transcription' | 'summarization' | 'action_items'

  result?: any
  error?: string
  createdAt: string
  completedAt?: string
